notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch only (curl with a real-browser User-Agent). robots.txt (https://www.luluandgeorgia.com/robots.txt) is a standard Shopify robots file with a blanket 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' and only disallows admin/cart/checkout/account/ajax paths; no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow present, so no tier restriction applied. Every /collections/<handle> page returned HTTP 200 on first request; no blocks encountered at any point, so Playwright/CDP and Claude-in-Chrome were not needed. TREE: Union of (1) /sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (817 collection URLs total) and (2) the homepage's rendered header/footer mega-menu, reconstructed from the on-page data-gtmevaction='Sub Nav - <TopNav> - Link Click' attributes (295 nav-menu link instances covering 223 unique /collections/ URLs). The mega-menu set was used as the authoritative category tree (matches STEP 2 rule 2's 'mega-menu navigation' source and is the site's own curated category structure) because the sitemap's extra ~600 URLs are almost entirely non-navigational: named-designer collaborations (e.g. sarah-sherman-samuel-*, amber-lewis-*, ginny-macdonald-*), seasonal/style mood-board pages (e.g. golden-hour, cozy-transition, parisian-escape), and rug/pillow attribute-filter pages not present in the mega-menu (size facets like 5-x-8-rugs/8-x-10-rugs, color facets like blue-color-rugs/brown-color-rugs, and extra construction facets like handwoven-rugs/hand-knotted-rugs/shag-rugs). These were excluded uniformly as View-All/Collection/promotional/filter pages per STEP 1 rule 6 and textile.md/storage.md Sec 27/35 (View All/Collections exclusion) rather than being cherry-picked, to keep the extraction reproducible. Within the retained mega-menu tree, each top-nav section (Rugs, Pillows + Throws, Bed + Bath, Decor + Tabletop, Walls, Furniture) was walked and every child link classified independently against textile.md and storage.md; every retained collection page was fetched and its own <h1> and canonical were checked to confirm the page matches the requested node (all matched). QTY: each collection page embeds a schema.org ItemList JSON-LD block (<script type='application/ld+json'>) with a 'numberOfItems' field that is the page's own full listing count (verified higher than the ~12-36 ListItem samples embedded alongside it, confirming it is a true total, not a sample count). This numberOfItems value was used verbatim as qty for every row; no counting/estimation was performed. EXCLUDED (neither array): /collections/rugs, /collections/bath, /collections/kitchen-dining (parent/umbrella URLs with valid retained subcategories, dropped per Parent Category URL rule); /collections/bestsellers-rugs (h1 'Bestsellers: Rugs', promotional bestseller cross-cut, not a product-type category); /collections/bath-accessories (h1 'Bath Accessories + Organization', qty 53 - sampled product list is a genuine mix of textile bath mats, non-storage generic accessories (trash can) and storage bins with no single dominant primary type, so it was dropped rather than force-classified); /collections/poufs-floor-pillows (h1 'Poufs + Floor Pillows', qty 14 - sampled listing is dominated by Poufs, which are furniture/ottoman-type seating per textile.md Sec 21, plus one pet-bed product; the few genuine Floor Pillow items inside cannot be isolated without fabricating a sub-count, so the whole node was dropped); /collections/curtain-rods-hardware, bathroom-faucets, bathroom-lighting, bathroom-wall-decor, wall-art, painting, vintage-wall-art, modern-contemporary-wall-art, wallpaper (+ its 6 sub-variants), mirrors, wall-mirrors, full-length-mirrors, wall-decor, wall-hooks, candle-sconces, decorative-objects, vases, picture-frames, decorative-trays-boxes, centerpiece-bowls, pots-planters, candles-home-fragrances, wreaths-garlands, dinnerware, drinkware-bar, serveware, flatware, fireplace-accessories, nursery-kids-decor, outdoor-decor, bookcases-shelving, sideboards-cabinets, bar-carts-cabinets, media-consoles, benches, dining-benches (Furniture/Lighting/Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories/Kitchen & Dining boundary items per both rule files - none are Textile or Storage). Two Textile rows (Throw Pillow Inserts, Duvet + Bed Pillow Inserts) and three rows (Storage + Organization, Kitchen Accessories + Organization, Wall Shelving + Cabinets) were retained but flagged LOW/MEDIUM confidence as genuinely ambiguous per the ambiguity-handling rules rather than dropped or forced.
